caption: The video captures the dark silhouette of an open hand cast upon a light-toned wooden surface, with a warm bright glow pooling on the right and a diagonal shadow edge at the upper left. The palm and four extended finger lobes hold a steady position throughout the excerpt, while only the thumb lobe visibly deforms. The thumb shadow is extended as a long, clearly separated protrusion angled down and to the right. This protrusion then draws inward, shortening toward the edge of the palm as the thumb tucks close. For a stretch of the clip the thumb remains retracted, leaving a compact silhouette against the wood. Near the latter portion the thumb pushes outward again, lengthening back into a distinct protrusion. The wooden background and the bright light patch stay fixed, indicating a static camera. The visible change is therefore a cycle of the thumb shadow folding in and unfolding out.
